audit_items.proof_trace: Both FlashLoan and ReserveFlashLoan structs are declared with no abilities (no drop, no store), making them hot potatoes enforced at the Sui Move VM level. Without drop, the VM aborts any transaction that does not consume these values; without store, they cannot be placed in any object field or dynamic field. The only destructuring paths are market.repay_flash_loan (market.move:836) and reserve.repay_flash_loan (reserve.move:244), so the receipt is guaranteed to be consumed within the same PTB.
